package e2e_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/thisisjun786/lina/internal/clientapi"
	"github.com/thisisjun786/lina/internal/core/boot"
	"github.com/thisisjun786/lina/internal/core/canon"
	"github.com/thisisjun786/lina/internal/core/ctlfiles"
	"github.com/thisisjun786/lina/internal/core/ledger"
	"github.com/thisisjun786/lina/internal/core/replay"
	"github.com/thisisjun786/lina/kit/protocol"
)

// Copy this file into the exact historical source's e2e/m1 directory. No
// production source is changed; the installed and replayed CLI is unmodified.
func TestRecordPreSharedRecall(t *testing.T) {
	base, err := filepath.Abs("../../..")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	commandBuilds.binaries["lina"] = filepath.Join(base, "lina-old")
	commandBuilds.binaries["lina-node"] = filepath.Join(base, "lina-node-old")
	var calls atomic.Int32
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		calls.Add(1)
		emitResponse(w, "Use violet ink in the notebook.", true)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	h, _ := installedConversationHarnessWithin(t, 2*time.Minute, server.URL)
	core := h.command("core", "--state-root", h.root, "--socket", h.socket)
	core.command.Env = append(core.command.Env, "PATH="+preRecallSandboxPath(t), "LINA_RESPONSES_BASE_URL="+server.URL+"/v1", "LINA_RESPONSES_MODEL=fixture-model", "LINA_RESPONSES_API_KEY=synthetic-key")
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if t.Failed() {
			t.Logf("Core stderr: %s", core.stderr.String())
		}
	})
	core.start(t)
	h.connect(core).Close()
	waitCoreReady(t, h)
	c, err := clientapi.DialWithCapabilities(h.ctx, h.socket, "test", []protocol.Capability{{Name: "memory", Version: "1.0"}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	agent, person := c.Welcome.Agents[0].AgentID, c.Welcome.PersonID
	memory := func(operation, text string) protocol.MemoryResult {
		t.Helper()
		if _, err := c.Memory(h.ctx, protocol.MemoryRequest{Operation: &operation, AgentID: &agent, Text: &text}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		frame, err := c.Receive(h.ctx)
		result, ok := frame.Payload.(protocol.MemoryResult)
		if err != nil || frame.Error != nil || !ok {
			t.Fatalf("memory: %+v %v", frame, err)
		}
		return result
	}
	remembered := memory("remember", "I prefer violet ink.")
	if remembered.ItemID == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing remembered identity")
	}
	for _, query := range []string{"violet", "amber"} {
		result := memory("list", query)
		if result.Items == nil {
			t.Fatal("missing memory results")
		}
		if query == "violet" {
			if len(*result.Items) != 1 || (*result.Items)[0].ItemID != *remembered.ItemID {
				t.Fatalf("old memory text match: %+v", result)
			}
		} else if len(*result.Items) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("old memory query ignored its text")
		}
	}
	c.Close()
	c, conversation := conversationClient(t, h)
	admittedTurn(t, h, c, conversation, "pre-shared-recall", "I keep a violet notebook. Which ink do I prefer?")
	c.Close()
	if calls.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("native model calls=%d", calls.Load())
	}
	p := h.command("export", "--socket", h.socket, "--agent", agent, "--conversation", conversation, "--since", "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z", "--until", "2100-01-01T00:00:00Z")
	p.start(t)
	p.wait(t, 0)
	var exported protocol.ExportResult
	if err := json.Unmarshal(p.stdout.Bytes(), &exported); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var manifest replay.Manifest
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(exported.Manifest), &manifest); err != nil || manifest.Exported != 1 || manifest.LeftOut != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("export: %+v %v", manifest, err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(exported.Directory, "episodes.jsonl"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var ep replay.Episode
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &ep); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(ep.Calls) != 0 || len(ep.Evidence.Assembly.Profile) != 1 || ep.Evidence.Assembly.Profile[0].ID != *remembered.ItemID {
		t.Fatal("export lost the memory-backed request")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(base, "episodes.jsonl"), data, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := filepath.Join(h.root, "historical-replay")
	p = h.command("replay", filepath.Join(base, "episodes.jsonl"), "--socket", h.socket, "--out", out)
	p.start(t)
	p.wait(t, 0)
	data, err = os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(out, "manifest.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var replayed struct {
		Replayed int `json:"replayed"`
		LeftOut  int `json:"left_out"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &replayed); err != nil || replayed.Replayed != 1 || replayed.LeftOut != 0 || calls.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("historical replay: %s calls=%d %v", data, calls.Load(), err)
	}
	h.stopCore(core)
	ctl, err := ctlfiles.Open(h.root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := ctl.Acquire(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	epoch, err := ctl.Epoch()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	db, err := canon.Open(h.ctx, canon.Config{Path: filepath.Join(h.root, "canon/canon.sqlite"), Epoch: epoch, Controls: ctl, Migrations: boot.ApplicationMigrations()})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, query := range []string{"notebook", "amber"} {
		hits, err := ledger.New(db, nil).Search(h.ctx, ledger.SearchQuery{AgentID: agent, PersonID: person, Text: query})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		found := false
		for _, hit := range hits {
			found = found || hit.ID == ep.Input.ID
		}
		if query == "notebook" && !found || query == "amber" && len(hits) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("old ledger search %q: %+v", query, hits)
		}
	}
	if err := db.Close(h.ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := ctl.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, dir := range []string{"canon", "materials", "versions"} {
		if out, err := exec.Command("cp", "-a", filepath.Join(h.root, dir), filepath.Join(base, dir)).CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("copy %s: %s %v", dir, out, err)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("old export/replay digest: %s; memory text match and ledger search passed", ep.Evidence.Hash)
}

// Expose only the sandbox launcher; host worker discovery is unrelated to replay.
func preRecallSandboxPath(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	name := "bwrap"
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		name = "sandbox-exec"
	}
	launcher, err := exec.LookPath(name)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	directory := t.TempDir()
	if err := os.Symlink(launcher, filepath.Join(directory, name)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return directory
}
